purpose: Independent source evidence gating for E218862V1 and HCMST, not retrospective claim to preregister earlier literature discovery

unit_contracts.question: Is archived replication package accessible and does its observed unit permit dyadic exposure/reciprocity or only college-survey outcomes?
unit_contracts.design: Crosscheck repository, AEA appendix and DOI, attempt direct browser downloads and container network; log HTTP/DNS failure, files actually inspected, license checks separately; classify match to target estimates
unit_contracts.gate: Do not call metadata codebook or paper a raw-file replication.

unit_contracts.question: Can independently collected individual panel measures assess relationship persistence, and what are the sampling/selection limitations?
unit_contracts.design: Examine exact primary sample description, attrition/weights, survey dates, documented partner status, partner history, breakups and platform use. Attempt official source download. Separate HCMST 2017 from 2009 sample; compare estimand against ESBM duration
unit_contracts.primary_outcome: Longitudinal survey eligibility classification with access/rights/missingness constraints, not synthetic comparison.
unit_contracts.gate: No effects/cross-tabulation until original data and permissible rights are verified.
